The '''Khorm system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]].
